name: summarize_minutes
text:
Summarize the following meeting minutes in five bullet points, then list open action items:

The committee met on Tuesday to review the quarterly infrastructure report. Water main replacements were 12 percent behind schedule because of supply delays, while road resurfacing finished early. Several residents raised concerns about noise from the new bus depot, and the transit authority agreed to install acoustic barriers by spring. The parks department requested additional funding for invasive species removal along the river trail, citing a 40 percent increase in knotweed coverage since last year. The finance director noted that interest rates on the municipal bonds had risen, increasing projected debt service by 3.1 million over five years. A pilot program for curbside composting in two neighborhoods diverted 18 tons of waste in its first three months, and staff recommended expanding it citywide.
